theorems.name: Submission.lpf_tde_chart_directional_deriv
theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (w : Eucl n) (A : Eucl n →L[ℝ] Eucl P) (B : Eucl n →L[ℝ] Eucl Q) (K : ℝ≥0) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → LipschitzOnWith K f (ball (Φ w) ρ) → HasFDerivAt Φ A w → HasFDerivAt (f ∘ Φ) B w → ∀ s : Eucl n, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (Φ w + t • A s)) (B s) 0 ∧ ‖B s‖ ≤ (K : ℝ) * ‖A s‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
